description: This file is a frontend React component for an object detection page. It manages state for the detection result, loading, error, and image URL, and coordinates the UI components for uploading an image, displaying detection results, and handling detection API calls.

methods.name: ObjectDetection
methods.description: React functional component that provides UI and logic for uploading an image and displaying object detection results.

methods.name: onFileSelected
methods.description: Async handler function invoked when a user selects a file; it sets state, calls the detectObjects API, and manages success or error responses.
